nodes.description: Public string state variable symbol of the Dogey token, set in the constructor.
Public string state variable name of the Dogey token, set in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable decimals, fixed to 18.
Public uint _totalSupply holding the total token supply.
Mapping address => uint recording token balances; debited/credited by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping address => address => uint of ERC20 allowances.
Public owner address set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Public pending owner address in the two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) returns c = a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) returns c = a * b with an overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) returns c = a / b with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function storing _newOwner into newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer when msg.sender == newOwner.
Constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve writing tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender] without double-spend protection.
ERC20 transferFrom debiting from balance and msg.sender allowance, crediting to.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval, a state-changing external call.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner function invoking transfer on an arbitrary token contract to owner.
Dogey constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, total supply and minting to a fixed address.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for authorization and balance bookkeeping.
Unchecked uint subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) performed after allowance state write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied arbitrary contract address.
Addition c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).

Parameter to (recipient) of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens (amount) of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens).

Parameter to (credited account) of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens (amount) of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).

Parameter spender of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Parameter spender, also the target contract of the external receiveApproval call, in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens approved and forwarded in approveAndCall.
Parameter data (bytes) forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress, the arbitrary external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter _newOwner stored into the newOwner state variable.

Parameter b of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter a of safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter b of safeSub(uint a, uint b).

Local variable c holding the checked quotient in safeDiv.

edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership using msg.sender == owner.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership updates newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the transfer.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
balances[address(0)] is the second operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
totalSupply() executes the unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
msg.sender balance in the balances mapping is debited by transfer.
tokens amount is subtracted from the sender balance via safeSub in transfer.
tokens amount is added to the recipient balance via safeAdd in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
msg.sender is the first-level key written into the allowed mapping by approve.
spender is the second-level key of the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens value is stored into allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
from account balance is debited in transferFrom.
tokens subtracted from the from balance via safeSub in transferFrom.
tokens credited to the to balance via safeAdd in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads and returns the balances mapping entry.
tokenOwner is the first-level key read in allowance.
spender is the second-level key read in allowance.
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry.
msg.sender is the approving account in approveAndCall.
spender key written into allowed in approveAndCall.
tokens value written into allowed in approveAndCall.
approveAndCall performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval after the allowance write, enabling reentrant callback.
spender is the attacker-controlled address targeted by the external receiveApproval call.
data bytes are forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the owner.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external call on an owner-supplied token contract.
tokenAddress is the target of the external transfer call.
tokens argument is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
owner is the recipient argument of the external ERC20 transfer.
parameter a is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
parameter b is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
safeAdd executes the guarded addition.
parameter a is an operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
parameter b is an operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
safeSub executes the guarded subtraction.
parameter a is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
parameter b is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
safeMul executes the guarded multiplication.
parameter a is an operand of the division in safeDiv.
parameter b is an operand of the division in safeDiv.
safeDiv executes the guarded division.
parameter a feeds the local result c in safeAdd.
parameter b feeds the local result c in safeAdd.
parameter a feeds the local result c in safeSub.
parameter b feeds the local result c in safeSub.
parameter a feeds the local result c in safeMul.
parameter b feeds the local result c in safeMul.
parameter a feeds the local result c in safeDiv.
parameter b feeds the local result c in safeDiv.
Dogey constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Dogey constructor sets the name state variable.
Dogey constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Dogey constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
Dogey constructor mints the total supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
msg.sender sending plain ETH hits the reverting fallback function.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter exists only to index the balances mapping inside balanceOf; fold it into the function node.
The to parameter is local to transfer and only identifies the recipient balance write; merge into transfer.
The tokens amount parameter is consumed solely by safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer; merge into transfer.
The spender parameter only keys the allowed mapping write in approve; merge into approve.
The tokens parameter is only stored into allowed inside approve; merge into approve.
The from parameter is only used to index balances and allowed in transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
The to parameter only receives the credited balance in transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only used for the safeSub/safeAdd debits and credits in transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter only keys the allowed mapping read in allowance; merge into allowance.
The spender parameter only keys the nested allowed mapping read in allowance; merge into allowance.
The spender parameter keys the allowance write in approveAndCall; merge into that function.
The tokens parameter is the approved amount in approveAndCall; merge into that function.
The data parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback, so merge it into the external call unsafe operation.
The tokenAddress parameter is the arbitrary external call target, so merge it into the external call unsafe operation.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded to the external transfer inside transferAnyERC20Token; merge into that function.
The _newOwner parameter is only stored into newOwner by transferOwnership; merge into transferOwnership.
Parameter a is a local operand of the addition in safeAdd; merge into safeAdd.
Parameter b is a local operand of the addition in safeAdd; merge into safeAdd.
Parameter a is a local operand of the subtraction in safeSub; merge into safeSub.
Parameter b is a local operand and the require bound in safeSub; merge into safeSub.
Parameter a is a local operand of the multiplication in safeMul; merge into safeMul.
Parameter b is a local operand of the multiplication in safeMul; merge into safeMul.
Parameter a is a local operand of the division in safeDiv; merge into safeDiv.
Parameter b is a local operand and the zero-check bound in safeDiv; merge into safeDiv.
Local result variable c is only meaningful inside safeAdd; merge into safeAdd.
Local result variable c is only meaningful inside safeSub; merge into safeSub.
Local result variable c is only meaningful inside safeMul; merge into safeMul.
Local result variable c is only meaningful inside safeDiv; merge into safeDiv.
